original: nanu yathā ghaṭavad bhūtalamiti vākyantathā bhūtalavān ghaṭaḥ, rūpavān ghaṭaḥ, ghaṭavapadrūm, ghaṭābhāvavad bhūtalam, bhūtalavān ghaṭābhāvaḥ, evamvidhāḥ, prayogāḥ, kathanna bhavanti saṃyogādīnāmubhayanirūpyattvāt iti cenna ? saṃyogasamavāyasvarūpāṇāmapi sambandhānānniścāyakaḥ kaścana sambandho bhavati |
analyzed: nanu yathā ghaṭa vat bhū talam iti bhū talavān ghaṭaḥ rūpavān ghaṭaḥ ghaṭa abhāvavat bhū talam bhū talavān ghaṭa abhāvaḥ evamvidhāḥ prayogāḥ katham na bhavanti saṃyoga ādīnām ubhaya nirūpya ttvāt iti ced na saṃyoga samavāya svarūpāṇām api kaścana sambandhaḥ bhavati

original: padārthadvaya eṣāṃ sambandhānānniścayākassambandho'nuyogitākhyaḥ pratiyogitākhyaśca |yadi saṃyogādīnāmanuyogitākhyassttadā tatra viśiṣṭabodhaḥ |yatra kevalapratiyogittvasambandha eva tatra na viśiṣṭabodhaḥ |
analyzed: padārtha dvaye eṣām pratiyogitā ākhyaḥ ca yadi saṃyoga ādīnām anuyogitā ākhyaḥ tatra viśiṣṭa bodhaḥ yatra kevala pratiyogitva sambandhaḥ eva tatra na viśiṣṭa bodhaḥ

original: ghaṭavad bhūtalamityatra ghaṭabhūtalayorthassaṃyogastasya niyāmakamanuyogittvambhūtale'to ghaṭavad bhūtalamiti bhavati bhūtalavān ghaṭa iti na bhavati |saṃyogasya ghaṭe pratiyogittvaṃ sambandho'nuyogittvābhāvāt |
analyzed: ghaṭa vat bhūtalam iti atra ghaṭa bhūtalayoḥ ṛthaḥ saṃyogaḥ tasya niyāmakam anuyogi ttvam bhū tala itas ghaṭa vat bhū talam iti bhavati bhū talavān ghaṭaḥ iti na bhavati saṃyogasya ghaṭe pratiyogi ttvam sambandhaḥ nuyogi ttva abhāvāt

original: dugdhavān ghaṭa iti bhavati ghaṭavad dugdhamiti na bhavati |yadyapi saṃyogasyobhayatra tulyattvameva tathāpyanuyogitvampratītibalād ghaṭa eva , pratiyogittvam dugdha evāto dugdhavān ghaṭa ityeva bhavati | evaṃ rūparasādiguṇānāṃ suvarṇāmrādidravyāṇāmparasparaṃ samavāyaḥ |
analyzed: dugdhavān ghaṭaḥ iti bhavati ghaṭa vat dugdham iti na bhavati yadi api saṃyogasya ubhayatra tulya ttvam eva tathā api anuyogi tvam pratīti balāt ghaṭe eva pratiyogi ttvam dugdhaḥ eva atas dugdhavān ghaṭaḥ iti eva bhavati evam rūpa rasa ādi guṇānām suvarṇa āmra ādi dravyāṇām parasparam samavāyaḥ

original: parantu guṇadravyayossamavāyasya niścāyakānuyogittvandravya eva na guṇādāvata eva rūpavatsuvarṇaṃ rasavadāmraphalam ityādi bhavati na tu suvarṇavad rūpam , āmraphalavān rasa ityādi bhavati | kriyā caitramaitradravyośca parasparaṃ samavāyasambandhaḥ | atra samavāyaniścayākānuyogittvamevātaścalanavān maitro bhāṣaṇavān caitra iti bhavati |
analyzed: parantu guṇa dravyayoḥ samavāyasya dravye eva na guṇa ādau atas eva rūpavat suvarṇam rasavat āmra phalam ityādi bhavati na tu suvarṇa vat rūpam āmra phalavān rasaḥ ityādi bhavati kriyā caitra maitra dravyoḥ ca parasparam samavāya sambandhaḥ atra samavāya niścayāka anuyogi ttvam eva atas calanavān maitraḥ bhāṣaṇavān caitraḥ iti bhavati

original: maitravaccalanaṃ caitravadbhāṣaṇamati na bhavati ? anuyogitvasya niścāyakasya kriyāyāmabhāvāt iti |
analyzed: maitra vat calanam caitra vat bhāṣaṇam ati na bhavati anuyogi tvasya niścāyakasya kriyāyām abhāvāt iti

original: yadyapi samavāyasambandho ghaṭapaṭādau parasparantathāpi samavāyaniyāmakānuyogittvamavayaveṣu pratiyogittvamavayaviṣu ataḥ "paṭavanti sūtrāṇi ghaṭavanti kapālāni" ityevamādayo vyavahārāḥ | sūtravān paṭaḥ, kapālavān ghaṭaḥ iti na bhavati pūrvoktayukteḥ | rājapuruṣa ityādau svattvasyāpi niyāmako niścāyakaḥ anuyogittvampuruṣe pratiyogittvaṃ rājani |
analyzed: yadi api samavāya sambandhaḥ ghaṭa paṭa ādau parasparan tathā api samavāya niyāmaka anuyogi ttvam avayaveṣu pratiyogi ttvam avayaviṣu atas paṭavanti sūtrāṇi ghaṭavanti kapālāni iti evamādayaḥ vyavahārāḥ sūtravān paṭaḥ kapālavān ghaṭaḥ iti na bhavati pūrva ukta yukteḥ rāja puruṣaḥ ityādau sva ttvasya api niyāmakaḥ niścāyakaḥ anuyogi ttvam puruṣe pratiyogi ttvam rājani

original: suvarṇaghaṭaḥ atra suvarṇasya ghaṭe janyatvaṃ saṃsargastasyānuyogittvaṃ ghaṭe, pratiyogittvaṃ suvarṇe, pratiyogittattvamviśeṣaṇatvarūpam anuyogittvamviśeṣyattvarūpam iti phalitārthaḥ |
analyzed: suvarṇa ghaṭaḥ atra suvarṇasya ghaṭe janya tvam saṃsargaḥ tasya anuyogi ttvam ghaṭe pratiyogi ttvam suvarṇe pratiyogi ttattvam viśeṣaṇa tva rūpam anuyogi ttvam viśeṣya ttva rūpam iti phalita arthaḥ

original: viśeṣyatā dvividhā sāvacchinnā niravacchinnā ca| ayaṃ ghaṭa ityādau ghaṭattvaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaghaṭaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatā idantvāvacchinnavatvena sāvacchinnā | kevalaghaṭa ityākārakajñāne ghaṭatvaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaghaṭaniṣṭhā viśeṣyatā niravacchinnā | pūrvajñāna idantvādikameva dharmmitāvacchedakam padārthaḥ |
analyzed: viśeṣyatā dvividhā sāvacchinnā niravacchinnā ca ayam ghaṭaḥ ityādau ghaṭattva niṣṭha prakāratā nirūpita ghaṭa niṣṭha viśeṣyatā idantva avacchinna vatvena sāvacchinnā kevala ghaṭaḥ iti ākāraka jñāne ghaṭa tva niṣṭha prakāratā nirūpita ghaṭa niṣṭhā viśeṣyatā niravacchinnā pūrva jñāne idantva ādikam eva dharmmitā avacchedakam padārthaḥ

original: viśeṣyatāvacchedakatāyā eva dharmmitāvacchedakatāpadārthatvāt |
analyzed: viśeṣya tā avacchedaka tāyāḥ eva dharmmi tā avacchedaka tā pada artha tvāt

original: prakāratāpi dvividhā sāvacchinnā niravacchinnā ca | ghaṭa ityākārakajñāne svarūpato ghaṭatvāderbhāvāt ghaṭaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitā ghaṭatvaniṣṭhā prakāratā niravacchinnā |
analyzed: prakāratā api dvividhā sāvacchinnā niravacchinnā ca ghaṭaḥ iti ākāraka jñāne svarūpataḥ ghaṭa tva ādeḥ bhāvāt ghaṭa niṣṭha viśeṣyatā nirūpitā ghaṭa tva niṣṭhā prakāratā niravacchinnā

original: ghaṭavad gṛhamityādau saṃyogasambandhāvacchinnagṛhaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaghaṭaniṣṭhāprakāratā ghaṭatvāvacchinnatvena sāvacchinnā |
analyzed: ghaṭa vat gṛham ityādau saṃyoga sambandha avacchinna gṛha niṣṭha viśeṣyatā nirūpita ghaṭa niṣṭhā prakāratā ghaṭa tva avacchinna tvena sā avacchinnā

original: uddeśyatāvidheyate api viṣayatāvat atirikte eva | yathā parvato vahnimānityatrasaṃyogasambandhāvacchinnavahnitvāvacchinnaprakāratānirūpitaparvatatvāvacchinnaviśeṣyateti | atra vahnau vidheyatā parvate uddeśyatā |
analyzed: uddeśya tā vidheya te api viṣayatā vat atirikte eva yathā parvataḥ vahnimān iti atra saṃyoga sambandha avacchinna vahni tva avacchinna prakāratā nirūpita parvata tva avacchinna viśeṣyatā iti atra vahnau vidheya tā parvate uddeśya tā

original: avacchinnatvañca
analyzed: avacchinna tvam ca

original: pratiyogittattvaviṣayatāvat viṣayatādāvapi ghaṭatvādessambandhaviśeṣa eva | ghaṭattvāvacchinnā viṣayatetyasya kesrthaḥ ? ghaṭattvaniṣṭhāvacchedakatānirūpitāvacchedyatāvatī viṣayatetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: pratiyogi ttat tva viṣayatā vat viṣayatā ādau api ghaṭa tva ādeḥ sambandha viśeṣaḥ eva ghaṭa ttva avacchinnā viṣayatā iti asya kesrthaḥ ghaṭa ttva niṣṭha avacchedaka tā nirūpita avacchedya tāvatī viṣayatā iti arthaḥ

original: avacchedakattvañca
analyzed: avacchedaka ttvam ca

original: śakyattve sati śakyavyāvarttakattvabhavacchedakattvam | yathā ghaṭa ityādau ghaṭatvam ghaṭapadaśakyam paṭādipadārthavyāvarttakañca |
analyzed: śakya ttve sati śakya vyāvarttaka ttva bhavat chedaka ttvam yathā ghaṭaḥ ityādau ghaṭa tvam ghaṭa pada śakyam paṭa ādi padārtha vyāvarttakam ca

original: anyūnānatipraśaktatvamavacchedakattvamvā | ghaṭa ityādau ghaṭattvanna nyūne varttate nādhike varttate kintu sakala eveti ghaṭattvamavacchedakam |
analyzed: anyūna anatipraśakta tvam avacchedaka ttvam vā ghaṭaḥ ityādau na nyūne varttate na adhike varttate kintu sakale eva iti ghaṭa ttvam avacchedakam

original: atrāyanniṣkarṣaḥ avacchedakatvaṃ svarūpasambandhaviśeṣaḥ sa ca kvacit pratiyogyaṃśaprakārībhūtadharmmatvam |
analyzed: atra ayat niṣkarṣaḥ avacchedaka tvam svarūpa sambandha viśeṣaḥ sa ca kvacid pratiyogi aṃśa prakārībhūta dharmma tvam

original: yathā prameyadhūmābhāvapratiyogitāyā avacchedakattvaṃ dhūmatve | kvacittu anatiriktavṛttitvantat | tacca dvividham | tatrādyam tacchūnyāvṛttitve sati tadadhikaraṇavṛtyabhāvāpratiyogitvam | yathā ghaṭābhāvapratiyogitāyā avacchedakatvaṃ ghaṭattve |
analyzed: yathā prameya dhūma abhāva pratiyogitāyāḥ avacchedaka ttvam dhūma tve kvacid tu anatirikta vṛttitvam tat tat ca dvividham tatra ādyam tad śūnya avṛtti tve sati tad adhikaraṇa vṛti abhāva apratiyogitvam yathā ghaṭa abhāva pratiyogitāyāḥ avacchedaka tvam ghaṭa ttve

original: dvitīyantu vyāvarttakatvasāmānādhikaraṇyasvaniṣṭhāvacchedyatākattvaitattritayasambandhena yat kiñcid dharmaviśiṣṭatvam yathā ghaṭakāraṇatāyā avacchekatvaṃ daṇḍe | kvacittu tadadhikaraṇasya tanniṣṭhadharmmāvacchedatakatvam, yathā mūle vṛkṣe na kapisaṃyogaśśākhāyām ityādau vṛkṣādhikaraṇasya śākhādervṛkṣaniṣṭhakapisaṃyogāvacchedakatvañca |
analyzed: dvitīyam tu vyāvarttaka tva sāmānādhikaraṇya sva niṣṭha avacchedya tāka tva etad tritaya sambandhena yat kiñcid dharma viśiṣṭa tvam yathā ghaṭa kāraṇatāyāḥ daṇḍe kvacid tu tad adhikaraṇasya tad niṣṭha dharma avacchedataka tvam yathā mūle vṛkṣe na kapi saṃyogaḥ śākhāyām ityādau vṛkṣa adhikaraṇasya śākhā ādeḥ vṛkṣa niṣṭha kapi saṃyoga avacchedaka tvam ca

original: yathā vā iha parvate nitambe hutāśanaḥ na śikhare ityatra nitambarūpadeśasya hutāśanāvacchedakatvam śikharasya tu hutāśanābhāvāvacchedakattvañca | idānīṃṃ cattvare gaurnāstītyādau etatkālespi gavābhāvasyāvacchedakattvam |
analyzed: yathā vā iha parvate nitambe hutāśanaḥ na śikhare iti atra nitamba rūpa deśasya hutāśana avacchedaka tvam śikharasya tu hutāśana abhāva avacchedaka ttvam idānīm cattvare gauḥ na asti ityādau etad kāle api gavābhāvasya avacchedaka ttvam

original: saṃbhavati laghau dharme gurau tadabhāvavādittyavacchedakattvaniruktyanusāreṇa sakalaparyyāptadharmaviśeṣāvacchedakatvasvīkāraḥ |
analyzed: saṃbhavati laghau dharme gurau tad abhāvavān iti avacchedaka ttva nirukti anusāreṇa sakala paryyāpta dharma viśeṣa avacchedaka tva svīkāraḥ

original: nanvacchedakatvaṃ kathamaṅgīkriyate tadasvīkṛtidaśāyāmapi ghaṭosstītyādau bodhasambhava iti cenna ? yadyavacchekadatvanna syāttarhyabhāvaviśiṣṭabuddhipratibadhyapratibandhakabhāvādīnāṅkeṣāmapi vyavasthā na syāt |
analyzed: nanu acchedaka tvam katham aṅgīkriyate tad asvīkṛti daśāyām api ghaṭoḥ sti ityādau bodha sambhavaḥ iti ced na syāt tarhi abhāva viśiṣṭa buddhi pratibadhya pratibandhaka bhāva ādīnām keṣām api vyavasthā na syāt

original: tadavyavasthāne ca sarva eva vyavahārā vilopamarheyuḥ tathā hi ghaṭo nāstīttyādiviśiṣṭabuddhau ghaṭattvāderavacchedakattvābhāve ghaṭapratiyogikābhāvakarttṛkāsattvettyarthasvīkāro "ghaṭo nāsti, nīla ghaṭo nāsti, ghaṭapaṭobhayannāsti" iti viśiṣṭabuddhīnāmparasparamvailakṣaṇyanna syāt | sarvatraiva ghaṭapratiyogikābhāvapratīteḥ |
analyzed: tad avyavasthāne ca sarve eva vyavahārāḥ vilopam arheyuḥ tathā hi ghaṭaḥ na asti itti ādi viśiṣṭa buddhau ghaṭa ttva ādeḥ avacchedaka ttva abhāve ghaṭa pratiyogika abhāva karttṛka asattva iti artha svīkāraḥ ghaṭaḥ na asti nīla ghaṭaḥ na asti ghaṭa paṭa ubhayat na asti iti viśiṣṭa buddhīnām parasparam vailakṣaṇyam na syāt sarvatra eva ghaṭa pratiyogika abhāva pratīteḥ

original: avacchedakatvasvīkāre tu ghaṭo nāstīti viśiṣṭabuddhau ghaṭattvamātraniṣṭhāvacchedakatādvayanirūpitapratiyogitākatvasya nīlaghaṭo nāstīti buddhau nīlattvaghaṭattvarūpadharmadvayaniṣṭhāvacchedakatādvayanirūpitapratiyogitākattvasya, ghaṭapaṭobhayannāstīti buddhau ca ghaṭattvapaṭattva
analyzed: avacchedaka tva svīkāre tu ghaṭaḥ na asti iti viśiṣṭa buddhau ghaṭa ttva mātra niṣṭha avacchedakatā dvaya nirūpita pratiyogitāka tvasya nīla ghaṭaḥ na asti iti buddhau nīla ttva ghaṭa ttva rūpa dharma dvaya niṣṭha avacchedakatā dvaya nirūpita pratiyogitāka ttvasya ghaṭa paṭa ubhayat na asti iti buddhau ca ghaṭa ttva paṭa ttva nirūpita pratiyogitāka ttvasya

original: ubhayatvarūpadharmatrayaniṣṭhāvacchedakatāpratiyogitākattvasyāvagāhanāt | viṣayavailakṣaṇyena pratītivailakṣaṇyamiti cenna ? ghaṭo nāstīti buddhau vaṭapratiyogitākābhāvaḥ | nīlaghaṭo nāstīti buddhau nīlattvaghaṭattvobhayattvādivailakṣaṇyena tayorvailakṣaṇyam avacchedakatāvailakṣaṇyameva tad vailakṣaṇyaṃ sādhayedattyasyāyuktattvāt |
analyzed: ubhaya tva rūpa dharma traya niṣṭha avacchedakatā pratiyogitāka ttvasya avagāhanāt viṣaya vailakṣaṇyena pratīti vailakṣaṇyam iti ced na ghaṭaḥ na asti iti buddhau vaṭa pratiyogitāka abhāvaḥ nīla ghaṭaḥ na asti iti buddhau nīla ttva ghaṭa ttva ubhaya ttva ādi vailakṣaṇyena tayoḥ vailakṣaṇyam avacchedakatā vailakṣaṇyam eva tat vailakṣaṇyam sādhayet atti asya ayukta ttvāt

original: avacchedakattvāssvīkāre saṃyogena ghaṭonāstīttyādau viśiṣṭattvāsambhavenaikavākyatvāsambhavaḥ | avacchedakatvasvīkāre tu saṃyokenetyasya saṃyogasambandhāvacchinnattvamarthaḥ tasya pratiyoginassambandhe pratiyogitāyāmanvayaḥ, pratiyogitāvacchedakasyasambandhesvacchinnapratiyogitāyāmanvayastathā ca saṃyogasambandhāvacchinnapratiyogitāsambandhena
analyzed: avacchedaka ttva svīkāre saṃyogena ghaṭaḥ na asti ityādau viśiṣṭa ttva asambhavena eka vākyatva asambhavaḥ avacchedaka tva svīkāre tu saṃyokena ityasya saṃyoga sambandha avacchinna ttvam arthaḥ tasya pratiyoginaḥ sambandhe pratiyogitāyām anvayaḥ pratiyogitā avacchedakasya sambandhe svacchinna pratiyogitāyām anvayaḥ tathā ca saṃyoga sambandha avacchinna pratiyogitā sambandhena

original: ghaṭavān abhāvaḥ, avacchinnasaṃyogasambandhāvacchinnapratiyogitāsambandhena vā ghaṭattvavānabhāva ityakāmenāpi bhavadbhiravacchedakattvamaṅgīkāryam ittyāstāṃ svarūpasambandhaviśeṣarūpāvacchedakattvaprabandhaḥ iti khaṇḍanapariśiṣṭagranthamatam |
analyzed: ghaṭavān abhāvaḥ avacchinna saṃyoga sambandha avacchinna pratiyogitā sambandhena vā ghaṭa ttvavān abhāvaḥ iti akāmena api bhavadbhiḥ avacchedaka ttvam aṅgīkāryam iti āstām svarūpa sambandha viśeṣa rūpa avacchedaka ttva prabandhaḥ iti khaṇḍana pariśiṣṭa grantha matam

original: atha jñānasya sattvaṃ kathamaṅgīkriyate viṣayasya kathanna sattvamaṅgīkriyate, vākyāt tathāṅgīkāre ubhayoreva tatsambhavāditi cenna ? vidhiniṣedhayordvayoreva jñānabhāsyattvāt | anyathobhāvapi na niṣpadyeyātām | aniṣpattirapi tathettyakāmenāpi jñānasatvamaṅgīkāryam |
analyzed: atha jñānasya sattvam katham aṅgīkriyate viṣayasya katham na sattvam aṅgīkriyate vākyāt tathā aṅgīkāre ubhayoḥ eva tad sambhavāt iti ced na vidhi niṣedhayoḥ dvayoḥ eva jñāna bhāsya ttvāt anyathā ubhau api na niṣpadyeyātām aniṣpattiḥ api tathā iti akāmena api jñāna satvam aṅgīkāryam

original: yadi ca yathā jñānamviṣayamavabhāsavati dīpasūryavat tathā viṣayospi jñānampratyujjīvayediti viṣayamvinā jñānodayāssambhavena viṣayasyāpi satvamavaśyaṃ svīkāryam ubhayoḥ parasparāpekṣatvāt | evamapi jñānānāṃ sarvānusyūtatvasyobhayavādisiddhattvāt tasya prāmāṇyamāvaśyakam viṣayasya tathābhāvānna satvam |

analyzed: mahā kaviḥ mahā vijñaḥ ityādau kavi tva ādau iva prakṛtyāḥ api aneka nāmārtha eka deśe pacana ādau apara nāmārthasya abheda anvaya bodhaka tayā karmadhāraya ttvasya sambhavāt stoka paktā ityādau amaḥ tādātmya vāci ttve tu tatpuruṣaḥ sambhavati eva kriyā viśeṣaṇaiḥ samāsaḥ eva avyutpannaḥ iti tu na yuktam stoka namrā stanābhyām ityādeḥ kālidāsa ādyaiḥ prayukta ttvāt

original: karmadhāraye samāse na śaktirnavā lakṣaṇā, nīlapadārthasyotpalapadārtho abhedasambandhenaivānvayopapattau śaktilakṣaṇānaṅgīkārāt | ata eva tatpuruṣāt karmadhārayo laghīyān bhavati | tathāhi niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayet itiśrutau bahuvrīhitatpuruṣasamāsāvapekṣya karmadhāraya eva lakṣaṇādyabhāvāllaghīyāniti |
analyzed: karmadhāraye samāse na śaktiḥ navā lakṣaṇā nīla padārthasya utpala padārthaḥ abheda sambandhena eva anvaya upapattau śakti lakṣaṇa anaṅgīkārāt atas eva tatpuruṣāt karmadhārayaḥ laghīyān bhavati tathā hi niṣāda sthapatim yājayet iti śrutau bahuvrīhi tatpuruṣa samāsau apekṣya karmadhārayaḥ eva lakṣaṇa ādi abhāvāt laghīyān iti

original: atredamusandheyam, niṣādasya saṃkarajātiviśeṣasya śūdrāntargatatayā "strīśūdrau nādhīyatām" ityanena niṣiddhattvād vedasāmānyānadhikārespi "niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayet" iti viśeṣaśrutiyājanānyathānupapattyaiva yāgamātropayuktamadhyayanaṃ niṣādasya kalpayate |
analyzed: atra idam usandheyam niṣādasya saṃkara jāti viśeṣasya śūdra antargata tayā strī śūdrau na adhīyatām iti anena niṣiddha tvāt veda sāmānya anadhikāre api niṣāda sthapatim yājayet iti viśeṣa śruti yājana anyathā anupapattyā eva yāga mātra upayuktam adhyayanam niṣādasya kalpayate

original: tathā ca srīśūdrāviti sāmānyaśāstraghaṭakādhyayanapadasya viśeṣataḥ prāptādhyayanetarādhyayanaparattvaṃ vācyam | tena niṣādasya yāgopayuktādhyayanetarādhyayananiṣedhaḥ, śūdrāntarasya tu adhyayanamātraniṣedhaḥ siddhyati iti |
analyzed: tathā ca srī śūdrau iti sāmānya śāstra ghaṭaka adhyayana padasya viśeṣataḥ prāpta adhyayana itara adhyayana para ttvam vācyam tena niṣādasya yāga upayukta adhyayana itara adhyayana niṣedhaḥ śūdra antarasya tu adhyayana mātra niṣedhaḥ siddhyati iti

original: kārakam

original: yaddhātūpasthāpyayādṛśārthe anvayaprakārībhūya bhāsate yaḥ subarthaḥ taddhātūpasthāpyatādṛśakriyāyāṃ kārakam | yathā vṛkṣāt patati, vyāghrād bibhetītyādau brāhmaṇāya dadāti, putrāya krudhyatītyādau dātreṇa chinatti, ghaṭattvena jānātītyādau sthālyāṃ pacati, śuktau bhāsata ityādau grāme gacchati, ghaṭampaśyatītyādau caitreṇa pacyate, ghaṭena
analyzed: yad dhātu upasthāpya yādṛśa arthe anvaya prakārībhūya bhāsate yaḥ sup arthaḥ tad dhātu upasthāpya tādṛśa kriyāyām kārakam yathā vṛkṣāt patati vyāghrāt bibheti ityādau brāhmaṇāya dadāti putrāya krudhyati ityādau dātreṇa chinatti ghaṭat tvena jānāti ityādau sthālyām pacati śuktau bhāsate ityādau grāme gacchati ghaṭam paśyati ityādau caitreṇa pacyate ghaṭena

original: bhūyata ityādau ca pataprabhṛtidhātvarthe patanādau pañcamyādyupasthāpito vibhāgādiḥ prakārībhūya bhāsata iti | tattaddhātṛpasthāpitatattatkriyāyāṃ vibhāgādikaṃ prakṛte kārakam |
analyzed: bhūyate ityādau ca pata prabhṛti dhātvarthe patana ādau pañcamī ādi upasthāpitaḥ vibhāga ādiḥ prakārībhūya bhāsate iti tad tad dhātṛ upasthāpita tad tad kriyāyām vibhāga ādikam prakṛte kārakam

original: anye tu yādṛśena nāmārthenāvacchinnasya subarthasya yādṛśadhātvarthesnvayaḥ sa tādṛśadhātvarthe kārakatayā vyapadiśyate | tena vṛkṣāt patatītyādau vṛkṣāderapi patanādikriyāyāmapādānādikārakavyavahāraḥ |
analyzed: anye tu yādṛśena nāma arthena avacchinnasya sup arthasya yādṛśa dhātvarthe anvayaḥ sa tādṛśa dhātvarthe kārakatayā vyapadiśyate tena vṛkṣāt patati ityādau vṛkṣa ādeḥ api patana ādi kriyāyām apādāna ādi kāraka vyavahāraḥ

original: pare tu kriyāprakārībhūtosrthaḥ kārakamiti śābdikāḥ |

original: kecittu kārakattvañca kriyānvitavibhaktyarthānvitattvam | asti ca karmādau kriyānvitasubvibhaktyarthānvaya iti samanvayaḥ | caitrasya taṇḍulaṃ pacatītyādau tu sambandhini caitrādau ṣaṣṭhyarthasambandhasya taṇḍulādināmārthānvitatayā kriyānanvitatvānnātivyāptiḥ | caitrasya pacatītyādāvapi taṇḍulādipadādhyāhāreṇaiva bodhaḥ |
analyzed: kecid tu kriyā anvita vibhakti artha anvita ttvam asti ca karma ādau kriyā anvita sup vibhakti artha anvayaḥ iti samanvayaḥ caitrasya taṇḍulam pacati ityādau tu sambandhini caitra ādau ṣaṣṭhī artha sambandhasya taṇḍula ādi nāma artha anvita tayā kriyā ananvita tvāt na ativyāptiḥ caitrasya pacati ityādau api taṇḍula ādi pada adhyāhāreṇa eva bodhaḥ

original: ṣaṣṭhyarthasambandhasya nāmārthenaiva tathā kriyāyāḥ karmattvādinaiva sākāṅkṣatayā parasparākāṅkṣāvirahāt | odanasya paktā maitrasya pāka ityādau karmattvakartṛttvārthikā ṣaṣṭhī kārakavibhaktireva |"kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti" ityanena vidhānāt | ata eva sambandhasya na kārakattvam' kriyāyogābhāvāt |
analyzed: ṣaṣṭhī artha sambandhasya nāma arthena eva tathā kriyāyāḥ karma ttva ādinā eva sākāṅkṣatayā paraspara ākāṅkṣā virahāt odanasya paktā maitrasya pākaḥ ityādau karma ttva kartṛ ttva arthikā ṣaṣṭhī kāraka vibhaktiḥ eva kartṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti iti anena vidhānāt atas eva sambandhasya na kāraka ttvam kriyā yoga abhāvāt

original: paretu kriyāprakārabhūtosrthaḥ kārakaṃ tacca ṣaḍvidham |

original: kartṛkarmādibhedena śeṣaḥ sambandha iṣyate iti śābdikāḥ |

original: ata eva "guruvipratapasvidurgatānāṃ pratikurvīta bhiṣak svabheṣajaiḥ" ityādau "sā lakṣmīrūpakurute yathā pareṣām" ityādau ca roge vipattau ityādināmnoḥ yathākramam adhyāhāraṇaiva bodhaḥ | ayambhāvaḥ, atrodhyāhṛtanāmārthenaiva ṣaṣṭhyarthasambandhasyānvayaḥ na tu kriyayā iti nātra kārakaṣaṣṭhī iti |

original: atra gadādharabhaṭṭācāryyāstu roga ityasya nādhyāhāraḥ kāryyaḥ | ṣaṣṭhyarthasambandhasya dhātvarthesnvayespi neyaṃ kārakavibhaktiḥ kintūpapadavibhaktirevetyāhuḥ | yadi adhyāhāramantarā kriyāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthasambandhānvayaḥ prāmāṇikastadā kriyānvitakartṛttvakarmattvādiṣaṭkānyatamānvayittvam kārakattvam bodhyam |

original: ata eva ca "carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hanti" ityādau nimittāderapi na kārakattvam | śābdikāstu kriyājanakattvayogyatābuddhiviṣayattvam kārakattvamityāhuḥ |

original: śrotramanassaṃyogaḥ śabdo vā vyāpāraḥ sambhavatyeveti na śrotrendriye karaṇalakṣaṇāvyāptiriti bruvate | navyāstu asādhāraṇameva kāraṇaṃ karaṇam | yadvilambāt prakṛtakāryyānutpādastatkāraṇattvasyāsādhāraṇattvātmakatayā kālādiṣu tādṛśakāraṇattvasyābhāvānnātivyāptiḥ | vyāpārattvenābhimatendriyasaṃyogādikameva pratyakṣe karaṇamityāhuḥ |

original: pṛthivī lakṣayatītyatra pṛthivīviśeṣyakalakṣaṇaprakārakajñānānukūlavyāpārosrthaḥ | pṛthivyā lakṣaṇamvakti ityatra pṛthivīviśeṣyakalakṣaṇaprakārajñānānukūlavyāpārosrthaḥ | paṭannāśayatītyatra paṭapratiyogikanāśānukūlavyāpārosrthaḥ | pratiyogittvāndvitīyārthaḥ | ghaṭamprati kāraṇaṃ daṇḍa ityatra ghaṭanirūpitakāraṇatāvān daṇḍa iti |

original: tṛtīyāvibhaktyarthāśca kartṛttva, karaṇattva, jñānajñāpyattva, abheda, sāhitya, pratiyogittva, nirūpitattva, niṣṭhattva, samavetattva, samānakālikattva, avacchinnattvādayaḥ | udāharaṇāni caitreṇa pacyate taṇḍula ityatra caitrakarttṛkapacanakarmībhūtastaṇḍula iti | paraśunā chinattītyatra paraśukaraṇakachedanakarttā caitrādiḥ |
analyzed: tṛtīyā vibhakti arthāḥ ca kartṛ ttva karaṇa ttva jñāna jñāpya ttva abheda sāhitya pratiyogi ttva nirūpita ttva niṣṭha ttva samaveta ttva samāna kālika ttva avacchinna ttva ādayaḥ udāharaṇāni caitreṇa pacyate taṇḍulaḥ iti atra caitra karttṛka pacana karmībhūtaḥ taṇḍulaḥ iti paraśunā chinatti iti atra paraśu karaṇaka chedana karttā caitra ādiḥ

original: dhūmena vahnimanuminomītyatra jñānajñāpyattvantṛtīyārthaḥ | dhānyena dhanavānityatra dhānyāsbhinnadhanavāniti bodhādabhedastṛtīyārthaḥ | putreṇāgataopitettyatra sāhityantṛtīyārthaḥ | rūpeṇarahito vāyurityatra rūpapratiyogikāsbhāvavān vāyuriti pratiyogittvantṛtīyārthaḥ |
analyzed: dhūmena vahnim anuminomi iti atra jñāna jñāpya ttvan tṛtīyā arthaḥ dhānyena dhanavān iti atra dhānya asbhinna dhanavān iti bodhāt abhedaḥ tṛtīyā arthaḥ putreṇa āgata opita itti atra sāhityan tṛtīyā arthaḥ rūpeṇa rahitaḥ vāyuḥ iti atra rūpa pratiyogika asbhāvavān vāyuḥ iti pratiyogi ttvan tṛtīyā arthaḥ

original: paryāptyā viśiṣṭamityatra paryāptiniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpakāsbhinnamitibodhānniṣṭatvamapi tṛtī | mayā jñāyata ityatra matsamavetakṛtiviṣayosvamiti bodhātsamavetattvamapi tṛ | dhāvatā puruṣeṇa pītimityatra dhāvanasamānakālikaṃ puruṣakartṛkampānamiti bodhāt samānakālikattvamapi tṛtīyārthaḥ |
analyzed: paryāptyā viśiṣṭam iti atra paryāpti niṣṭha prakāratā nirūpaka as bhinnam iti bodhāt niṣṭa tvam api tṛtī mayā jñāyate iti atra mad samaveta kṛti viṣayaḥ svam iti bodhāt samaveta ttvam api dhāvatā puruṣeṇa pītim iti atra dhāvana samāna kālikam puruṣa kartṛkam pānam iti bodhāt samāna kālika ttvam api tṛtīyā arthaḥ

original: yadviṣayakattvena jñānasyānumitivirodhittvamityatra yadviṣayakattvāvacchinnetipratītyā avacchinnatvantṛtīyārthaḥ | evamanyespi kalpanīyāḥ |

original: caturthyarthāḥ uddeśyattva, tṛptiprayojakattva, samavetattva, niṣpattiprayojakattva, vikārittva, vṛddhiprayojakattva, āśritattva, viṣayattva, svāpaharaṇecchāprayojyecchāviṣayattva, prayojakattva, icchādhīnecchāviṣayattvādayaḥ | kramaśastatra viprāya gāndadāti bhūtebhyo balimitibhūtatṛptiprayojako baliriti |
analyzed: caturthī arthāḥ uddeśya ttva tṛpti prayojaka ttva samaveta ttva niṣpatti prayojaka ttva vikāri ttva vṛddhi prayojaka ttva āśrita ttva viṣaya ttva sva apaharaṇa icchā prayojya icchā viṣaya ttva prayojaka ttva icchā adhīna icchā viṣaya ttva ādayaḥ kramaśas tatra viprāya gān dadāti bhūtebhyaḥ balim iti bhūta tṛpti prayojakaḥ baliḥ iti

original: gave sukhaṃ gosamavetaṃ sukham, yūpāya dāru yūpaniṣpattiprayojakībhūtandārū | kuṇḍalāyāṣṭāpadamityatra kuṇḍalavikāryyāṣṭāpadamiti | vṛkṣāyodakaṃ siñcatītyatra vṛkṣavṛddhiprayojakībhūtasecanamiti vṛddhiprayojakattvantṛtīyārthaḥ | nāradāya rocate kalaha ityatra nāradāśritaprītiviṣayībhūtaokalaha iti āśritattvamapi catu |
analyzed: gave sukham go samavetam sukham yūpāya dāru yūpa niṣpatti prayojakībhūtan dārū kuṇḍalāya aṣṭāpadam iti atra kuṇḍala vikāryā aṣṭāpadam iti vṛkṣāya udakam siñcati iti atra vṛkṣa vṛddhi prayojakībhūta secanam iti vṛddhi prayojaka ttvam tṛtīyā arthaḥ nāradāya rocate kalahaḥ iti atra nārada āśrita prīti viṣayībhūtaḥ iti āśrita ttvam api catur tvam

original: puṣpebhyaḥ spṛhayatītyatra puṣpaviṣayakecchāvānayamitibodhāt viṣayattvamapi caturthyarthaḥ | edhebhyo gacchatītyatra indhanāharaṇecchāprayojakībhūtayatnavāniti pratītyāṃ prayojakatvañcaturthyarthaḥ | yāgāya yātītyatra yāgadarśanecchādhīnecchāviṣayagamanakartāsyamiti bodhāt icchādhīnecchāviṣayattvamapi caturthyarthaḥ | ityevamanyespi kalpanīyāḥ |
analyzed: puṣpebhyaḥ spṛhayati iti atra puṣpa viṣayaka icchāvān ayam iti bodhāt viṣaya ttvam api caturthī arthaḥ edhebhyaḥ gacchati ityatra indhana āharaṇa icchā prayojakībhūta yatnavān iti pratītyām prayojaka tvam caturthī arthaḥ yāgāya yāti ityatra yāga darśana icchā adhīna icchā viṣaya gamana kartā āsyam iti bodhāt icchā adhīna icchā viṣaya ttvam api caturthī arthaḥ iti evam anye api kalpanīyāḥ

original: pañcamyarthāḥ avadhimattva, pratiyogittva janyattva, svakartṛkoccāraṇādhīnattva, nirūpitattva, jñānajñāpyattva, ārambhaparyyantatadapekṣattvādayaḥ | vṛkṣātparṇampatatītyatra vṛkṣāvadhikapatanāśrayamparṇamiti bodhaḥ | ghaṭādbhinnaopaṭa ityatra ghaṭapratiyogikabhedāślayaopaṭa iti pratiyogittvampañca |
analyzed: pañcamī arthāḥ avadhimattva pratiyogi ttva janya ttva sva kartṛka uccāraṇa adhīna ttva nirūpita ttva jñāna jñāpya ttva ārambha paryyanta tad apekṣa ttva ādayaḥ vṛkṣāt parṇam patati iti atra vṛkṣa avadhika patana āśrayam parṇam iti bodhaḥ ghaṭāt bhinnaḥ opaṭaḥ iti atra ghaṭa pratiyogika bheda āślaya opaṭaḥ iti pratiyogi ttvam pañcamī

original: daṇḍād ghaṭaḥ daṇḍajanyo ghaṭaḥ sādhyābhāvavatosvṛttiritisādhyāsbhāvavānitinirūpitattvampañcamyarthaḥ | vahnimān dhūmādityatra dhūmajñānajñāpyattvampañcamyarthaḥ | ājananātpaṭhatītyatra jananārambhakapāṭhakarteti bodhādārambhattvamapi | āmaraṇāddhyāyatītyatra maraṇaparyantadhyānapratītyā paryantaḥ pañcamyā arthaḥ |
analyzed: daṇḍāt ghaṭaḥ daṇḍa janyaḥ ghaṭaḥ sādhya abhāvavatoḥ vṛttiḥ iti sādhya asbhāvavān iti nirūpita ttvam pañcamī arthaḥ vahnimān dhūmāt iti atra dhūma jñāna jñāpya ttvam pañcamī arthaḥ ā jananāt paṭhati iti atra janana ārambhaka pāṭha kartā iti bodhāt ārambha ttvam api ā maraṇāt dhyāyati iti atra maraṇa paryanta dhyāna pratītyā paryantaḥ pañcamyāḥ arthaḥ

original: ācāryātpurāṇāṃ śraṇotītyatra ācāryakartṛkoccāraṇādhīnaśravaṇakartāsyamiti bodhāt tatkarttṛkoccāraṇādhīnattvamapi pañcamyarthaḥ | ayamasmātprabala ityatraitadapekṣaprābalyāvanayamiti bodhāt tadapekṣattvamapi pañcamīvibhaktyarthaḥ | evamanyespi |
analyzed: ācāryāt purāṇām śraṇoti iti atra ācārya kartṛka uccāraṇa adhīna śravaṇa kartā āsyam iti bodhāt tad karttṛka uccāraṇa adhīna ttvam api pañcamī arthaḥ ayam asmāt prabalaḥ iti atra etad apekṣa prābalyau anayam iti bodhāt tad apekṣa ttvam api pañcamī vibhakti arthaḥ evam anye api

original: ṣaṣṭhyarthāḥ ekonaśataṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthāḥ śataṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthā vā | viṣayattva, viśeṣyattva, prakārattva, pratiyogitva, nirūpittva, vṛttitvasvāmitānirūpitasvattva, pratipādakattva, uccaritattva, pratiyogittvānuyogittve, abhedaṃ, karttṛttvaṃ, karmattvaṃ, avayavattvaṃ, karaṇattvaṃ, samavetattvaṃ,
analyzed: ṣaṣṭhī arthāḥ ekonaśatam ṣaṣṭhī arthāḥ śatam ṣaṣṭhī arthāḥ vā viṣaya ttva viśeṣya ttva prakāra ttva pratiyogi ttva nirūpi ttva vṛtti tva svāmi tā nirūpita sva ttva pratipādaka ttva uccarita ttva pratiyogi ttva anuyogi ttve abhedam karttṛ ttvam karma ttvam avayava ttvam karaṇa ttvam samaveta ttvam

original: svasamabhivyāhṛtapadārthatāvacchedakajātiśūnyaṣaṣṭhyantapadārthavyāvṛttattvādayaḥ | krameṇodāharaṇāni grāmasya jñānamityatra grāmaviṣayakaṃ jñānamitibodhād viṣayattvam | ghaṭasya lakṣaṇaṃ kathayatītyatra ghaṭaviśeṣyakalakṣaṇaprakārajñānānukūlavyāpārapratīttyā viśeṣyattvaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ |
analyzed: sva samabhivyāhṛta padārtha tā avacchedaka jāti śūnya ṣaṣṭhī anta padārtha vyāvṛtta ttva ādayaḥ krameṇa udāharaṇāni grāmasya jñānam iti atra grāma viṣayakam jñānam iti bodhāt viṣaya ttvam ghaṭasya lakṣaṇam kathayati iti atra ghaṭa viśeṣyaka lakṣaṇa prakāra jñāna anukūla vyāpāra pratīttyā viśeṣya ttvam ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ

original: pṛthivyā lakṣaṇasya jñānaṃ janayatīttyatra pṛthivīviśeṣyakalakṣaṇaprakārajñānānukūlavyāparapratītyā prakārattvaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | śatro nāśa ityatra śatrupratiyogiko nāśa iti pratīttyā pratīyogittvaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | ghaṭasya kāraṇamittyatra ghaṭanirūpitakāraṇatāvānayamitipratīttyāṃ nirūpitattvaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ |
analyzed: pṛthivyāḥ lakṣaṇasya jñānam janayati itti atra pṛthivī viśeṣyaka lakṣaṇa prakāra jñāna anukūla vyāpara pratītyā prakāra ttvam ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ nāśaḥ iti atra śatru pratiyogikaḥ nāśaḥ iti pratīttyā ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ ghaṭasya kāraṇam itti atra ghaṭa nirūpita kāraṇatāvān ayam iti pratīttyām nirūpita ttvam ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ

original: ghaṭasya rūpamityatra ghaṭavṛttirūpamiti pratītyā vṛttittvaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | rājñaopuruṣa ityatra rājaniṣṭhattvāmitānirūpitasvattvavānayamiti bodhāt | svāmitānirūpitasvattvamapi ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | gurornāma mahattvamittyādau gurupratipādakanāmamahattvamiti bodhāt pratipādakattvaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ |
analyzed: ghaṭasya rūpam iti atra ghaṭa vṛtti rūpam iti pratītyā vṛtti ttvam ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ iti atra rāja niṣṭhattva amitā nirūpita svattvavān ayam iti bodhāt svāmitā nirūpita svattvam api ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ guroḥ nāma mahattvam ityādau guru pratipādaka nāma mahattvam iti bodhāt pratipādaka ttvam ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ

original: āptasya vākyam gurorvākyamittyādau āptoccaritam vākyamiti pratītyā uccaritavtaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ |
analyzed: āptasya vākyam guroḥ vākyam iti ādau āpta uccaritam vākyam iti pratītyā uccaritavtam ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ

original: bhūtalasya ghaṭasya ca saṃyogassambandhaḥ ityatra bhūtalānuyogikaḥ ghaṭapratiyogikassaṃyoga iti pratīteopratiyogittvānuyogittve ṣaṣṭhyarthau | rāhośśiraḥ nāmnordvayamittyatra rāhvabhinnaṃ śiraḥ nāmābhinnaṃ śiraḥ nāmābhinnaṃ śiraḥ nāmābhinnaṃ dvayamitipratītyā abhedospi ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ |
analyzed: bhū talasya ghaṭasya ca saṃyogaḥ sambandhaḥ iti atra bhū tala anuyogikaḥ ghaṭa pratiyogikaḥ saṃyogaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī arthau rāhoḥ śiraḥ nāmnoḥ dvayam iti atra rāhu abhinnam śiraḥ nāma abhinnam śiraḥ nāma abhinnam dvayam iti pratītyā ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ

original: caitrasya gamanamittyatra caitrakartṛkaṃ gamanamitipratītyā kartṛttvaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | jagataoparipālaka ittyatra jagatkarmakaparipālanapratīttyā karmatvamapi ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | devadattasya pāṇirityatra devadattāvayavapāṇiriti bodhādavayavattvaṃ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ |
